name: Answer or Die
source:
You must answer questions for 60 seconds on a game show called "Answer or Die" and win the host's favor... or else you die.

[From [url=https://beamingghost.itch.io/answer-or-die] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你必须在名为“答对或死亡”的电视节目中回答60秒的问题，赢得主持人的好感……否则就会死。

[来源：[url=https://beamingghost.itch.io/answer-or-die]itch.io[/url]]
